The following events took place in '''58 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] is [[Mission to Hurikane|sent]] to [[Hurikane]] to negotiate with the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]]-rock [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. He makes peace with them and receives purple [[Hurrikaine crystal]]s that he uses to build his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Stones">{{Tales|13|Stones}}</ref>
*[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is orphaned when his family of farmers is murdered by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], and is picked up by former [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protector]] [[Jaster Mereel]].<ref name="OS">''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''</ref>
*The [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] gain representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
*[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] arrives on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ST">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref>
